content_text: I’ve always liked the ambiance of M’s flat with the table and floor lighting. I especially like the two small table lamps positioned on either side of the fireplace (on the bookcase shelf). Do you recall the make/model of those small table lamps? Looking to source for similar prop lighting. Thank you.
